entry.title: Download Macronio - Macros & Calories on the App Store!

link.title: Download Macronio - Macros & Calories on the App Store!

entry.content:
Macronio is the fastest way to see what you’ve eaten — and what you’ve cooked — at a glance.

Log foods in seconds with a live USDA search, build your own recipes in minutes, and watch the calorie ring and macro bars fill in real-time. All your data travels with you via iCloud Sync. No ads, no clutter — just the numbers that matter.

Why you’ll love it:

  • Minimalist design that never gets in your way
  • Breakfast • Lunch • Dinner tracking with one-tap portion entry
  • Custom foods & recipes – reuse your go-to ingredients or full dishes
  • Create on the spot – add a food or recipe directly from the search screen
  • iCloud Sync on by default – log on iPhone and pick up on iPad
  • Dark & Light Mode, fully private — built 100 % with Apple technologies

Hit your macro goals the simple way. Download Macronio today and fuel your day with clarity.

Download on the App Store

entry.title: Download Wealthio - Net Worth Tracker on the App Store!

link.title: Download Wealthio - Net Worth Tracker on the App Store!

entry.content:
See your complete financial position—assets, liabilities, and net worth—in one clear multi-currency balance sheet.

Wealthio is a focused personal finance app for people who want clarity without the complexity of budgeting tools, transaction feeds, or bank integrations. Add what you own, record what you owe, and see your net worth in your preferred currency.

Track cash, bank accounts, investments, crypto, real estate, vehicles, mortgages, loans, and other assets or debts. Wealthio brings everything together in a calm, easy-to-understand financial snapshot.

As you use Wealthio, it automatically builds a private history of your net worth. See up to 90 days of recent changes directly on the dashboard, or upgrade to Wealthio Premium to explore your complete financial history with expanded periods, individual record inspection, advanced metrics, and detailed summaries.

KEY FEATURES

• Track assets and liabilities in one place • See total assets, total liabilities, and net worth • Follow up to 90 days of recent net worth history • Convert your entire balance sheet into your preferred currency • Support for 20+ global currencies • Currency and Bitcoin price updates • Privacy mode to hide financial totals when needed • Manual entry with no bank connection required

WEALTHIO PREMIUM

Upgrade to unlock:

• Complete net worth history • Expanded time periods and individual record inspection • Advanced metrics and financial summaries • Optional iCloud sync across your devices • Home Screen widgets

Choose between Monthly and Annual subscription options. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled through your Apple Account settings.

Your financial data stays on your device by default. iCloud sync is optional and is only enabled when you choose it.

Wealthio is designed to feel clear, private, and intentional.

No transaction feeds. No budgeting clutter. Just a simple view of what you own, what you owe, and how your financial position changes over time.

Some features require a Wealthio Premium subscription.

Download on the App Store
entry.summary: See your complete financial position—assets, liabilities, and net worth—in one clear multi-currency balance sheet.

entry.title: Download Hungrymons on the App Store!

link.title: Download Hungrymons on the App Store!

entry.content:
Hungrymons is all about a casual and fun experience everyone can enjoy.

With a simple and intuitive gameplay mechanic, you must feed the monsters on the screen to earn points, make combos and beat your own highscore! But be careful, avoid the bombs and poison flasks so you can make your way to the top!

Gotta feed’em all!

Download on the App Store
